title: School Library Bookshelf Location Finder
problem: Younger students get lost in our school library looking for science storybooks, because books get misplaced across 12 different cupboards.
idea: A digital library map. Pick the kind of book you want and the map tells you which cupboard to go to. I made the list by scanning book covers with Google Lens and sorting them with Gemini.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What book do you want?
widgets.intro: Tap a book type and the library map shows its cupboard.
widgets.question: I am looking for:

options.label: Science stories
options.result: Go to Cupboard 3 (blue sticker), top two shelves.

options.label: Maps & atlas
options.result: Go to Cupboard 8 (yellow sticker), bottom shelf.

options.label: Not in the list
options.result: Ask the library teacher. Maybe the book is borrowed now.
options.te: లైబ్రరీ టీచర్‌ని అడగండి. పుస్తకం ఎవరైనా తీసుకుని ఉండవచ్చు.

widgets.heading: ✅ Am I a good library helper?

items.text: I put the book back in the same cupboard.
I check the colour sticker before keeping it.
I write my name in the register when I borrow.
I return the book on time.
I help a younger student find a book.
items.te: చిన్న పిల్లలకు పుస్తకం వెతకడంలో సహాయం చేస్తాను.

bands.text: Good! Try a few more habits.
Start with putting books back in the right place.

how: Stick one colour sticker and a number on each of the 12 cupboards.
Use Google Lens to scan each book cover and copy the title text.
Paste all titles into Gemini and ask it to sort them into groups like Science, Stories, Maps, Maths.
Decide which group goes in which cupboard and put a matching sticker on each book spine.
In Scratch, draw the library map. Make a button for each group that makes the right cupboard flash.
Put the Scratch map on the library computer and teach the younger students to use it.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student organising my school library. Here is a list of book titles: [paste titles]. Sort them into simple groups (Science stories, Telugu stories, English stories, Maps, Maths, General knowledge) and make a table with title and group.
